engines.label: current
engines.notes: Scalar reference plus per-arch kernels (arm64 NEON SDOT, x86_64 AVX2 and AVX-512 VNNI) compiled into one binary and selected at runtime via CPUID. Loads the listed .bin format versions; v12 adds the MTP byte-0 head and untied lm_head, v13 adds the hybrid-trunk fp32/fp16 path. An optional trailing stop-sequence header field ends a turn on a marker instead of generating to max_new. The binary for the running host resolves through readers.paths.engine_binary_path().
